verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API paths for many core platform operations: API-only onboarding as an alternative to the hosted UI, the Legal Entity Management API, balance account creation via the Configuration API, and split instructions on payment endpoints. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and some functions are described as Dashboard/Customer Area tools (fee control, webhook delivery troubleshooting). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Dashboard-managed functions such as fee control and webhook troubleshooting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build your own UI and collect required user data. You make API requests to create resources and submit the user data to Adyen.
